mapper.insert: INSERT INTO process_state (process_type, process_id, current_step, total_steps, completed_steps, status, metadata, started_at, updated_at, completed_at) VALUES (#{processType}, #{processId}, #{currentStep}, #{totalSteps}, #{completedSteps}, #{status}, #{metadata}::jsonb, #{startedAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{completedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM process_state WHERE process_type = #{processType} AND process_id = #{processId}
mapper.update: UPDATE process_state SET current_step = #{currentStep}, completed_steps = #{completedSteps}, status = #{status}, metadata = #{metadata}::jsonb, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, completed_at = #{completedAt} WHERE process_type = #{processType} AND process_id = #{processId}
